mostWorthwhile.text: Packaging fat into chylomicrons was the most worthwhile construction: the planned picture and prose connect absorbed fat to a named particle and prepare its distinct lymph route.

leastWorthwhile.text: The separate glucose and amino-acid crossings felt repetitive. The planned pictures show where each goes but do not explain how either crosses the intestinal cell.

surprise.text: Fat enters lymph first, unlike glucose and amino acids, which travel in blood toward the liver.

arbitrary.text: Combining glucose and amino acids into portal blood felt somewhat abstract: both already entered blood separately, though their shared route toward the liver gave it a purpose.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how the nutrient routes connect to the larger body model. The contrasting routes were interesting, though I would want more explanation of the crossing mechanisms.
